data.name: Secrets of Asherah 2
data.detailed_description:
Awaken in the Kingdom of Asherah

Step into a pixel-art online realm rebuilt on the Intersect engine. Explore towns, forests, rivers, and dungeons in a world without rigid quests or classes—your story unfolds entirely through player choice in a persistent world that evolves with the community. Begin in benevolent Arthos, trade and take risks in chaotic Keld, or navigate the disciplined, orderly Rhine.

Craft Your Legacy

Dive into life-skills like mining, woodcutting, fishing, farming, cooking, alchemy, and blacksmithing. Level skills from novice to Master, crafting everything from basic tools to advanced gear. Experiment with multi-step recipes and manage your own housing instance. Every harvest and hammer strike contributes to your wealth in a player-driven economy.

Conquer and Evolve

Engage in skill-based combat with responsive swings, parries, and spells. Wield melee weapons, bows, or magic, and increase your combat skills to wield more powerful gear. Level up to 1000, mastering your favorite weapons and abilities. Face roaming monsters in dangerous wilds, and respawn at the Temple of Asherah in Arthos when you fall. Test your skills in PvP at the Arthos Coliseum for duels and team battles.

Forge Bonds in a Shared Realm

Form parties for efficient hunting or join guilds with shared halls, farms, mines, and territories. Explore instanced areas together, trade directly with other players, and host events like seasonal celebrations or guild competitions. Build lasting friendships in a respectful, family-friendly community, shaping the world through cooperation and rivalry.

A World Alive With Mystery

From lush animated tilesets and flowing rivers to ambient wildlife sounds, Asherah pulses with life. Explore interconnected continents by boat, manage survival needs like hunger and rest, and uncover hidden secrets in forests, caves, tundras, and marshes. Daily login bonuses and ongoing developer updates keep the world fresh and evolving.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 893 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: 1024x768 or higher display resolution recommended. Mouse recommended for crafting/combat precision (Steam Deck trackpads work great!)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Quad Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: N\A
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080 resolution for best experience.
